blockingIssues.description: CLI command flow does not invoke data-home initialization before state-writing commands, so first-use auto-creation of ~/.mlx-stack/ is not reliably enforced.
Catalog nested type corruption paths can raise raw exceptions (e.g., ValueError) instead of CatalogError, violating clear error handling expectations.
Catalog data/tests encode six distinct family values while milestone expectation groups into five families, creating a contract mismatch.
Dependency binary lookup maps vllm-mlx to `vllm` instead of `vllm-mlx`, causing false missing-tool detection.
Installed-version parsing is fragile to ANSI-formatted `uv tool list` output, causing missed version detection/mismatch warnings.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update canonical CLI structure guidance to match the live codebase (`src/mlx_stack/cli/*.py` with command registration in `src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py`) instead of `commands/` + `cli.py` references.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple reviews (project-scaffolding, hardware-detection, configuration-management, dependency-management) observed stale guidance pointing workers to nonexistent/legacy paths.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Ensure the required `cli-feature` skill is registered/invokable in worker sessions and align procedural steps with current repository wiring expectations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Repeated reviewer evidence shows feature metadata requiring `cli-feature` while worker transcripts report `Skill "cli-feature" not found`; one review also noted procedure mismatch for command registration location.

rejectedObservations.observation: Stale library catalog path note (`src/mlx_stack/catalog/` vs `src/mlx_stack/data/catalog/`).
Validation contract wording ambiguity around '5 families' grouping.
Document ANSI quirks of `uv tool list` in shared library now.
